title: Curriculum Vitae
text:
Profile
Biostatistics leader pairing hands-on industry development and FDA regulatory experience across the drug-development lifecycle with a strong academic and methodological foundation. Currently Senior Manager, Biostatistics at Pfizer (Associate Director–equivalent) and a member of the Data Science & Analytics India leadership team, leading a team of statisticians across global Oncology and Inflammation & Immunology programs. Former FDA Oncology Center of Excellence primary reviewer with hands-on NDA/BLA experience, product-labelling negotiation, and pioneering use of real-world evidence and external-control cohorts.

title: Curriculum Vitae
text:
Experience

Jun 2024 – present
Senior Manager, Biostatistics — Pfizer Healthcare India Pvt. Ltd., Chennai, India

Associate Director–equivalent statistical leader on the Data Science & Analytics India leadership team, shaping statistical strategy across global Inflammation & Immunology development programs.
Lead and develop a team of statisticians — building talent, strengthening statistical capability, and fostering a culture of scientific excellence.
Build enterprise capability in real-world evidence and target trial emulation, partnering with Statistics leadership to advance next-generation evidence generation.
Advance modern quantitative methods across programs, including endpoint consolidation, real-time trial monitoring, and reproducible quantitative science.



May 2022 – May 2024
Manager, Biostatistics — Pfizer Healthcare India Pvt. Ltd., Chennai, India

Trial-statistician leadership across Inflammation & Immunology programs spanning pediatric ulcerative colitis and inflammatory bowel disease, with medical-affairs support and priority programs in atopic dermatitis, asthma, and COPD — from study design through regulatory deliverables.
Oncology statistical leadership on targeted-therapy programs across non-small cell lung cancer and melanoma, spanning protocol design, analysis planning, and submission-supporting deliverables.



Feb 2020 – Apr 2022
Mathematical Statistician (Primary Reviewer) — U.S. Food and Drug Administration, Oncology Center of Excellence, Silver Spring, MD, USA

Primary statistical reviewer for NDA, BLA, and IND submissions across multiple oncology indications, delivering independent assessments that informed regulatory decisions and product labelling.
Reviewed applications spanning gastric and gastroesophageal cancers, cholangiocarcinoma, and additional solid-tumor indications, as well as an oncology biosimilar and a supportive-care (otoprotection) program.
Led sponsor–agency interactions and labelling negotiations, translating statistical findings into clear regulatory positions.
Contributed to one of the FDA’s early evaluations of real-world evidence and external-control cohorts through review of a pediatric neuroblastoma program.



Aug 2019 – Jan 2020
Biostatistician — Nemours Children’s Health System, Jacksonville, FL, USA

Led end-to-end statistical strategy for investigator-initiated pediatric studies across multiple therapeutic areas — concept and design through analysis, interpretation, and publication.



Aug 2017 – Jul 2019
Assistant Professor of Statistics (tenure-track) — University of Northern Colorado, Greeley, CO, USA

Taught graduate and undergraduate statistics, mentored students, and led applied and methodological research.
Served as statistical consultant on cross-disciplinary research collaborations across the university.



Aug 2012 – Aug 2017
Graduate Assistant & Instructor — University of Florida, Department of Statistics, Gainesville, FL, USA

Instructor, teaching assistant, and statistical consultant while completing PhD research.



Jun 2011 – Apr 2012
Statistician — Cytel Statistical Software & Services Pvt. Ltd., Pune, India

Supported early-stage sponsor studies through statistical programming, analysis, and study-support activities.

title: Curriculum Vitae
text:
Research focus
Much of my recent work sits in two places: using target trial emulation to bring observational data to bear on questions trials answer slowly or not at all, and endpoint and estimand strategy — deciding what a trial should measure before arguing about how to analyse it.

title: Abhishek Bhattacharjee, PhD
text:
I’m Associate Director, Biostatistics at Pfizer in Chennai, on the Data Science & Analytics India leadership team, where I lead a team of statisticians across global Inflammation & Immunology development programs.
Before Pfizer I was a primary statistical reviewer at the FDA’s Oncology Center of Excellence. That mix — regulatory judgement on one side, development strategy on the other — is what I bring to the work.

title: Abhishek Bhattacharjee, PhD
text:
Oncology
My current role sits in Inflammation & Immunology, but oncology is where I built my regulatory foundation.
At the FDA I reviewed NDA and BLA submissions across multiple oncology indications — gastric and gastroesophageal cancers, cholangiocarcinoma, and other solid tumors, alongside an oncology biosimilar and a supportive-care program — and led sponsor–agency interactions and labelling negotiations.
At Pfizer I served as trial statistician on targeted-therapy programs in non-small cell lung cancer and melanoma.

title: Abhishek Bhattacharjee, PhD
text:
Innovation & research
I’m most interested in the methods that change what a development program can actually learn:

Real-world evidence and target trial emulation — building enterprise capability at Pfizer to support next-generation evidence generation
External-control cohorts — contributed to one of the FDA’s early evaluations of non-traditional evidence, through the review of a pediatric neuroblastoma program
Endpoint consolidation and real-time trial monitoring across development programs
Empirical Bayes and adaptive design, carried over from my PhD at the University of Florida

Fifteen peer-reviewed papers to date — the list is on Google Scholar and in my CV.
